summary: Sunrise Realty Trust, Inc. (SUNS) filed an 8-K disclosing entry into a merger agreement with Southern Realty Trust Inc. (SRT) and its wholly owned subsidiary Merger Sub. Under the terms, SRT will merge with and into Merger Sub, which will survive as a wholly owned subsidiary of SUNS. The merger and related stock issuance were unanimously approved by a special committee of independent and disinterested directors, as well as the board. The transaction is intended to qualify as a tax-free reorganization under Section 368(a). Closing requires approval of the stock issuance by a majority of votes cast by SUNS stockholders at a special meeting. This is an acquisition where SUNS is the acquirer.
